People at Apple don't just build products, they craft the kind of experiences that have revolutionized entire industries. The diverse collection of our people and their ideas inspire innovation in everything we do. Imagine what you could do here. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it. The Apple Service Engineering (ASE) team builds and provides the systems and infrastructure that fuel Apple's services, including iCloud, iTunes, Siri, and Maps. We are the foundation on which Apple's software developers build the products our customers love.
We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join ASE Security SRE, working in close partnership with development teams to operate and mature services spanning host access, disk encryption, and fleet-wide security agents. These services are foundational to how Apple's infrastructure is secured and operated at scale. This role works day to day with the engineering teams who build these services, sharing ownership of their reliability, operational quality, and on-call.
We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer to join a team working directly alongside development partners across host access, disk encryption, and fleet-wide security tooling. You will share responsibility for the reliability, operability, and security posture of the services in this area, contributing from design and planning through to production operation and incident response. You will have a seat in planning and design reviews, and be accountable for operational quality alongside the engineers who build the service.
You will help define and drive adoption of sound operational practices, grounded in what actually works for the team and the threat model in front of them. You will bring deep comfort with host and fleet level operations, and the practical realities of rolling out and operating security tooling across a large, heterogeneous environment.
Partner with development teams on the design, rollout, and operation of host and fleet level security tooling
Own or co-own operational health, deployment safety, and incident response for services and agents in the aligned area
Participate in on-call for the services you support, alongside the development team
Drive improvements to fleet-wide deployment, rollback, and coverage mechanisms as a standing part of the team's engineering work
Represent operational health in planning and review forums for the area
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related engineering field, or equivalent experience. Advanced degree preferred
7+ years in a Site Reliability Engineering or infrastructure focused role
Significant experience in at least one of: Swift, Java, Rust, Golang, C or C++
Deep knowledge of Linux security primitives, systems internals, packaging, and container security
Strong understanding of distributed systems design patterns and their security implications
Experience running Tier 1 services with 24/7 support expectations
*Strong understanding of operating systems concepts including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, and systems application performance tuning
Knowledge of common infrastructure components including network architecture, server fleet provisioning and configuration, and load balancing
In-depth knowledge of technologies such as TLS/SSL, TCP/IP, and X.509 certificates
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with fleet-wide agent or security tooling deployment across heterogeneous environments
Understanding of macOS security primitives
Strong grasp of SRE principles including monitoring, alerting, error budgets, and fault analysis
Experience with Kubernetes and virtualized infrastructure at scale

apple-200695556-0836.text:
At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. We're building a massive, real-time conversational experience from the ground up, one that will reach users at Apple scale. It sits at the intersection of Generative AI, Information Retrieval, and Knowledge Graphs.
We're looking for a senior machine learning engineer to own the conversational intelligence layer: the agent's reasoning and tool-calling, the low-latency LLM inference behind it, and the knowledge services that keep every response accurate and grounded. You'll partner closely with teams across Apple to bring it to production.
This is a hands-on role for an engineer who has shipped conversational AI and LLM systems to production and cares about latency as much as model quality. You'll work closely with AI/ML scientists and engineers across the stack. You'll design multi-turn conversational experiences, build agent logic that plans and calls tools, and develop query understanding models that turn natural language into structured intent. You'll also make large and small models fast and cost-efficient enough to serve in real time.
Just as importantly, you'll help make sure every response is accurate and grounded. You'll build and scale knowledge graph services that resolve, enrich, and expand user requests with low latency and also connect the system to real-time data sources so its answers stay current. Finally, you'll build the evaluation that keeps all of it honest: automated and LLM-as-judge evaluation for multi-turn conversations, built into the development workflow so regressions are caught before they reach users.
Orchestrate tools and grounding: Own the agent's planning and tool-calling layer, including tool schemas, dynamic tool selection, and structured output generation. Ground every response in retrieval, knowledge graph, and real-time data.
Build conversational understanding: Design and ship conversational flows, including intent understanding, context tracking, and disambiguation, using LLM- and small-model-based query parsers that feed downstream retrieval and ranking.
Optimize LLM inference: Profile and reduce serving latency and cost through distillation, quantization, compact output formats, dynamic batching, KV-cache tuning, and semantic caching. Use inference runtimes such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, and ONNX Runtime, and decide when a request needs a large model, a small model, or none at all.
Build autograded evaluation: Design and own automated evaluation for conversational and generative quality, including multi-turn rubrics, LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, judge calibration against human ratings, and error-analysis tooling. Integrate eval runs into CI.
Connect offline metrics to online outcomes: Define offline metrics that predict user-facing wins, and partner on the A/B tests that confirm them.
Ship models and services to production: Take models and services from experiment to the live request path with proper versioning, monitoring, and rollback, and own their quality, latency, and reliability after launch.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with research scientists, engineers, and product teams to turn recent research in conversational AI, retrieval, and inference into systems that hold up in production.
Minimum Qualifications
Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field
7+ years of experience as a software or machine learning engineer, with a significant focus on conversational AI, search, or LLM-powered systems
Strong programming skills in Go and Python, plus at least one of Java or Scala
Hands-on experience building and shipping conversational AI or dialogue systems: intent and slot understanding, multi-turn context management, clarification, and disambiguation
Experience building LLM-powered applications in production, including prompt design, tool/function calling, structured output generation, and agentic orchestration patterns
Demonstrated LLM inference-optimization experience: distillation, quantization, batching, KV-cache tuning, caching, and profiling to find real bottlenecks rather than guessing at them
Hands-on experience deploying and serving LLMs or ML models directly in the production request path, using serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, Triton, or TorchServe
Experience with knowledge graphs and low-latency lookup and retrieval services
Fluency with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (transformers, PEFT)
Familiarity with cloud environments (including AWS) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset
Preferred Qualifications
Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field
Experience fine-tuning and distilling LLMs for task-specific use, such as query parsing, classification, and response generation, using techniques such as LoRA/adapters and teacher/student setups
Experience designing knowledge graph schemas, building graph compilation and ingestion pipelines, and working with graph databases such as TigerGraph or Neo4j
Deep experience with KV stores and in-memory serving for low-latency lookups (e.g., Cassandra, Redis, SSTables)
Experience calibrating LLM judges against human judgments for multi-turn conversations, including inter-annotator agreement and judge reliability tracking
Experience with personalization and memory in conversational systems, and applying privacy principles such as data minimization and on-device processing
Experience implementing safety guardrails for LLM-powered agents, including prompt-injection defenses and adversarial evaluation
Familiarity with experiment tracking and data/model versioning tools (MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC)
Deep understanding of distributed systems and service design, and experience architecting and leading projects with cross-functional stakeholders
Published work or patents in conversational AI, information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or efficient inference

apple-200695375-0836.text:
Every time your iPhone detects a car crash and calls for help, your Apple Watch notices you’ve started a workout before you tell it to, or “Hey Siri” wakes up without you touching a thing, there’s a tiny, always-on processor making it happen. At Apple, the Always-On Processor (AOP) firmware team builds the software that runs on that silicon. We write the firmware that listens to the world through accelerometers, gyroscopes, barometers, magnetometers, and more, while sipping just microwatts of power.
Our work sits underneath features people rely on every day, from emergency response and fitness tracking to camera image stabilization, spatial audio, intuitive device interactions, and all-day battery life. Because the same platform spans iPhone, Apple Watch, iPad, Mac, AirPods, and Vision Pro, a line of code you write can ship in products used by hundreds of millions of people. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something!
The Core Operating Systems (Core OS) team is responsible for the foundational software used in Apple’s most iconic and beloved products. We’re looking for a talented Embedded Software Engineer to join the Always On Platform Systems team. This team is uniquely positioned to contribute to all Apple products and has a wide range of responsibilities including: pre-silicon software development, hardware bringup, sensor driver development and integration, as well as future framework and feature development for the Always On technology area. The team also has oversight responsibilities in architecture, compute and memory resourcing, and cross-functional feature deployment.
The ideal candidate must possess a genuine passion for hardware/software integration, software quality, and the ability to collaborate and communicate effectively across teams. This is a rare opportunity to help build cutting-edge foundational technologies and have a direct impact on Apple’s widely loved products across the globe.
Design, develop, and test embedded software for low-power, resource-constrained environments.
Optimize code for performance, power consumption, and memory footprint.
Collaborate with silicon and hardware engineers to define and implement system-level capabilities.
Contribute to the architecture and design of the Always-On platform.
Debug and troubleshoot complex software issues in a real-world context.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices.
Work closely with other teams across Apple to integrate your work seamlessly into the broader ecosystem.
Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in embedded systems technology.
Minimum Qualifications
Proven experience in embedded software development.
Strong proficiency in C/C++ programming.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
BS degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent skills/experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS).
Familiarity with hardware architectures (ARM preferred).
Solid Hardware and Software debugging skills.
Understanding of common peripheral busses (SPI/I2C/USB)
Experience with sensor integration.
Knowledge of Apple platforms and technologies.

apple-200695296-0836.text:
Do you love building and scaling infrastructure that delights millions of customers? At Apple, we believe reliability is a feature. We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join our team in overseeing the performance and availability of our core backend services in News, Stocks, Weather, Books and Creator Studio applications.
As a SRE, you won’t just be responding to alerts; you will be shaping the evolution of our observability strategy, a mentor for incident management, and a champion for automation. You will help us refine our "Golden Signals" and ensure our Kubernetes-based ecosystem remains world-class.
System Architecture: Designing and implementing the next generation of our telemetry and alerting systems.
Reliability Engineering: Defining SLOs/SLIs and ensuring our monitoring strategy captures the true health of the user experience.
Operational Excellence: Reducing operational load through software; if you have to do it twice, you’ll want to automate it.
Collaboration: Partnering with App Dev teams to influence the "design for reliability" phase of the software development lifecycle.
Mentorship: Acting as a technical lead for junior members and off-shore partners, providing guidance on runbook development and disaster recovery.
Minimum Qualifications
Experience: 5+ years in SRE, DevOps, or Infrastructure roles with a proven track record of managing high-traffic, internet-facing production environments.
Data Systems: Experience with Solr, Kafka, Cassandra, or Postgres or other Data services in a distributed environment.
Kubernetes Expertise: Deep experience building and operating container orchestration systems (EKS/GKE/Vanilla K8s). You should be comfortable troubleshooting from the networking layer up to the application pod.
Cloud Proficiency: Hands-on experience designing and maintaining resilient infrastructure on public cloud providers (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Deep systems and infrastructure knowledge and Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving skills.
Scripting & Automation: Strong ability to code at a scripting level (Python or Go preferred) to automate toil and build self-healing systems.
Incident Leadership: Experience leading incident response, performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implementing blameless post-mortems to improve system resilience.
Infrastructure as Code: Proficient in Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi to manage immutable infrastructure.
Observability Champion: Expert knowledge of the 4 Golden Signals (Latency, Traffic, Errors, and Saturation). Proficiency with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Splunk is essential.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Preferred Qualifications
Search & Data: Specialized experience operating and tuning Solr or Elasticsearch at scale.
Networking: Strong understanding of TCP/IP, Load Balancing (ELB/ALB), and Service Mesh (Istio/Linkerd).

apple-200695484-0836.text:
Do you want to build the intelligence that makes Apple devices feel like they truly understand the people who use them? Our mission is to personalize the user experience based on where you go, when, and what those places mean to you. You experience our work whenever you see a suggested location in Maps or Calendar, browse your Memories in Photos, or your phone engages Do Not Disturb While Driving or remembers where you parked.
Join the Location Technologies team to help take these experiences to the next level, delivering features that surprise and delight customers around the world. We are looking for curious, talented engineers who love solving sophisticated problems, enjoy collaborating with others, and are excited to build great software that runs on-device. You do not need to be a location expert—if you are a strong engineer who loves to learn, we want to hear from you.
You will join a team that works at the intersection of sensing, machine intelligence, and user experience. We partner closely with teams across Apple, including sensing, Siri, and apps, to turn raw signals from the device into contextual understanding that makes a real difference in people's daily lives.
In this role, you will drive complex, cross-functional projects from idea to shipping feature. You will:
Partner with teams across Apple to define and deliver new location and context-based features that delight customers.
Lead projects end to end: explore ideas, shape requirements, design solutions, and see them through to production.
Design and implement algorithms and on-device software, and integrate them into production code.
Work with real-world data from a variety of local sensors, such as GPS, WiFi, and accelerometer, to understand how our features behave in the wild.
Test your work, dog-food it, collect metrics, and iterate. Sweat the edge cases—an issue that impacts 1% of a billion devices is a big issue.
Build privacy-preserving algorithms. Privacy is core to how Apple does business, so we deliver intelligent, proactive experiences through on-device processing, without sensitive data coming back to Apple or being exposed to third parties.
Our team is a group of engineers dedicated to quality, thoughtful design, and learning from one another. We have an encouraging, growth-focused culture where we support each other and provide mentorship on both technical and leadership skills. We are looking for people who share those values and want to grow with us.
Minimum Qualifications
Software engineering experience: Solid fundamentals and a track record of developing commercial software.
Languages: Familiarity with languages such as Swift, Objective-C, C++, or C is helpful. If you are strong in one and curious about the others, you will fit right in.
On-device development: Experience in on-device software development, including an interest in optimizing for system performance (memory, CPU, power) so our software delivers a high level of service while sipping battery.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional projects across multiple teams or organizations.
Preferred Qualifications
User-focused: Passion for quality, attention to detail, and delivering outstanding user experiences.
Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work across teams with different expertise and responsibilities, plan collaboratively, and execute flexibly, including when the path forward is uncertain.
Experience with location, sensing, or related domains (GPS/GNSS, WiFi positioning, motion and inertial sensing) is a bonus, but not required.
Background in areas such as data analysis, signal processing, or machine learning is a plus.

Would you like to build the data foundation behind Apple's Business and Education products, at a scale that touches millions of enterprises, schools, and the devices and services they depend on?
Apple's Business and Education organization builds the infrastructure, platforms, and services behind Apple's offerings for enterprise and education customers: device management, identity, and subscription services, and the classroom apps built on top of them. Our team owns the data engineering behind all of it, from pipelines and lakehouse architecture through analytics reporting. We build the foundational data products, tools, and frameworks that let our partners in Product, Engineering, Business, and Data Science make data-driven decisions, and we are building a new generation of AI-native capabilities on top of that foundation.
We are looking for an exceptional data engineer with a strong background in distributed data processing, demonstrable data intuition, and a passion for continuously improving the way we use data. You think architecturally, you care about data that people can trust, and you are energized by hard, high-leverage problems at scale.
Build trustworthy, scalable data products that power data discovery, self-serve analytics, and experimentation.
Build data-powered products and product experiences: the data pipelines, services, and APIs behind customer-facing features in Apple's Business and Education offerings, held to production standards for latency, freshness, and reliability.
Design the lakehouse architecture, data models, and quality practices that every consumer relies on, from dashboards to AI agents.
Build the semantic layer, metadata, and documentation that give AI agents the context to answer questions over our data.
Build reusable tools and frameworks, including telemetry and ingestion with platform partners, that make the whole team faster.
Partner with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Product to set data strategy.
Lead through design and production-readiness reviews, own projects from discovery to rollout, and mentor engineers.
Minimum Qualifications
8+ years in software and data engineering, building large-scale data systems with Spark and other distributed technologies (Flink, Trino/Presto, Druid, or similar).
Proficiency in Java, Scala, or Python, writing code that is readable, testable, and observable in production.
Strong SQL, and experience with relational databases (MySQL, Postgres), analytics stores (Druid, Apache Pinot), and query engines (Trino, Spark SQL).
Deep expertise in data architecture and data modeling, with the judgment to trade off query performance, governance, and extensibility.
A track record delivering batch, streaming, and CDC (change data capture) pipelines on lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Delta Lake or Iceberg, AWS or equivalent), with the orchestration, quality checks, and alerting that catch breakage before consumers do.
AI fluency: you use AI-assisted tools daily to build, test, and operate pipelines, and you know where they need a human check.
Context engineering for data: you design the metadata, semantic definitions, documentation, and lineage that let LLMs and agents find, query, and reason over data correctly.
You take loosely defined problems to completion with minimal guidance and meticulous attention to detail.
You communicate clearly, lead technical strategy discussions, and influence across a complex, matrixed organization.
BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Deep stream-processing experience (Apache Flink, Spark Streaming, Kafka Streams) for real-time products.
Search systems (Elasticsearch, Solr) or NoSQL datastores (HBase, Cassandra, MongoDB).
Google Cloud or Azure, in addition to AWS.
Data for machine learning: feature pipelines, vector search, or retrieval-ready datasets.
Data systems in regulated or privacy-sensitive environments.
Technical leadership across multiple teams or concurrent projects.

apple-200695530-0836.text:
Would you like to build the data foundation behind Apple's Business and Education products, at a scale that touches millions of enterprises, schools, and the devices and services they depend on?
Apple's Business and Education organization builds the infrastructure, platforms, and services behind Apple's offerings for enterprise and education customers: device management, identity, and subscription services, and the classroom apps built on top of them. Our team owns the data engineering behind all of it, from pipelines and lakehouse architecture through analytics reporting. We build the foundational data products, tools, and frameworks that let our partners in Product, Engineering, Business, and Data Science make data-driven decisions, and we are building a new generation of AI-native capabilities on top of that foundation.
We are looking for an exceptional data engineer with a strong background in distributed data processing, demonstrable data intuition, and a passion for continuously improving the way we use data. You think architecturally, you care about data that people can trust, and you are energized by hard, high-leverage problems at scale.
Build trustworthy, scalable data products that power data discovery, self-serve analytics, and experimentation.
Build data-powered products and product experiences: the data pipelines, services, and APIs behind customer-facing features in Apple's Business and Education offerings, held to production standards for latency, freshness, and reliability.
Design the lakehouse architecture, data models, and quality practices that every consumer relies on, from dashboards to AI agents.
Build the semantic layer, metadata, and documentation that give AI agents the context to answer questions over our data.
Build reusable tools and frameworks, including telemetry and ingestion with platform partners, that make the whole team faster.
Partner with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Product to set data strategy.
Lead through design and production-readiness reviews, own projects from discovery to rollout, and mentor engineers.
Minimum Qualifications
8+ years in software and data engineering, building large-scale data systems with Spark and other distributed technologies (Flink, Trino/Presto, Druid, or similar).
Proficiency in Java, Scala, or Python, writing code that is readable, testable, and observable in production.
Strong SQL, and experience with relational databases (MySQL, Postgres), analytics stores (Druid, Apache Pinot), and query engines (Trino, Spark SQL).
Deep expertise in data architecture and data modeling, with the judgment to trade off query performance, governance, and extensibility.
A track record delivering batch, streaming, and CDC (change data capture) pipelines on lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Delta Lake or Iceberg, AWS or equivalent), with the orchestration, quality checks, and alerting that catch breakage before consumers do.
AI fluency: you use AI-assisted tools daily to build, test, and operate pipelines, and you know where they need a human check.
Context engineering for data: you design the metadata, semantic definitions, documentation, and lineage that let LLMs and agents find, query, and reason over data correctly.
You take loosely defined problems to completion with minimal guidance and meticulous attention to detail.
You communicate clearly, lead technical strategy discussions, and influence across a complex, matrixed organization.
BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Deep stream-processing experience (Apache Flink, Spark Streaming, Kafka Streams) for real-time products.
Search systems (Elasticsearch, Solr) or NoSQL datastores (HBase, Cassandra, MongoDB).
Google Cloud or Azure, in addition to AWS.
Data for machine learning: feature pipelines, vector search, or retrieval-ready datasets.
Data systems in regulated or privacy-sensitive environments.
Technical leadership across multiple teams or concurrent projects.

apple-200682498-0836.text:
At Apple, new ideas quickly transform into products, services, and customer experiences that delight millions. This innovation is fueled by cutting-edge hardware developed within the Hardware Engineering Group. As a vital part of this organization, the System RF group designs and characterizes wireless systems across Apple’s flagship products—including iPhone, Watch, iPad, Mac, and Audio—ensuring world-class performance from prototype to production. Within this organization, the Smart Data Ecosystem team empowers product evolution by building AI/ML-powered analytics that unlock critical insights from complex wireless manufacturing and design data. The team is currently seeking a Senior AI Development Engineer to architect, develop and deploy scalable AI solutions internally.
Join a team operating at the intersection of hardware, data, and AI—architecting intelligent software tools that solve complex system optimization problems where you can directly influence the performance of Apple products used worldwide!
This role is dedicated to transforming engineering productivity and enabling cutting-edge hardware design through the strategic application of machine learning and generative AI. As a Senior AI Engineer, you will bridge the gap between complex hardware engineering workflows and state-of-the-art artificial intelligence. You will architect intelligent agents capable of automating repetitive engineering tasks, analyzing high-dimensional data to surface hidden trends, and tapping into decades of historical design intelligence. By building these systems, you will empower engineers to arrive at critical decisions with unprecedented speed and accuracy, directly influencing the next generation of Apple innovation.
Integrate Large Language Models: Direct the integration of state-of-the-art LLMs (such as Anthropic Claude, Mistral, and Gemini) via both cloud-based APIs and secure on-premise deployments.
Orchestrate Tool-Use and Integration: Develop safe and efficient mechanisms for agents to invoke APIs, query high-dimensional databases, and interact with custom internal engineering tools.
Optimize Retrieval and Knowledge: Architect and maintain advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and oversee LLM fine-tuning processes to align models with domain-specific engineering data.
Design and Architect Multi-Agent Systems: Lead the development of sophisticated multi-agent architectures, specifically focusing on complex orchestration, coordination, and persistent state management.
Scalable Deployment: Oversee the transition of AI solutions from experimental prototypes to robust, production-scale internal services that handle complex, high-volume engineering requests.
Minimum Qualifications
7+ years of experience in AI/ML-related projects, with a proven track record of architecting and deploying production-scale Generative AI solutions.
Masters or PHD in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science or a related field.
Expert-level knowledge of multi-agent system design, including sophisticated orchestration, coordination, and persistent state management.
Strong command of Agent Communication Protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A) and frameworks for designing distributed agentic workflows.
Expert-level software development skills with a solid foundation in architectural design principles and the creation of scalable, modular systems.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional architecture discussions and translate ambitious product goals into robust technical system designs.
Preferred Qualifications
10+ years of professional experience in AI/ML-related projects, demonstrating a long-term track record of innovation and technical leadership.
Proven ability to build efficient interfaces for agents to invoke APIs, query high-dimensional databases, and interact with custom toolsets.
Proficiency in Python (Core and Async) and a strong command of FastAPI or Flask for serving high-performance AI endpoints.
Proven success in deploying Generative AI solutions tailored to complex, high-dimensional, and domain-specific engineering data.
Prior experience overseeing the full lifecycle of large-scale software applications deployed within an enterprise-grade production environment.
Deep understanding of model selection, intelligent routing, and fallback strategies to ensure reliability across multiple LLM providers.
Experience developing and implementing rigorous Gen AI evaluation systems to measure the performance, safety, and accuracy of deployed agents

apple-200685118-0157.text:
Help us build the data foundation for capacity planning across Apple’s data and AI infrastructure. The Apple Data Platform organization is looking for a Software Engineer to build data pipelines, models, and analytical tools that help us understand infrastructure demand, utilization, capacity, and cost. The role will initially focus on third-party cloud infrastructure including GPUs, TPUs, compute, and storage and will expand over time to Apple-owned infrastructure. You will work closely with engineering, CIBO, Finance, and Procurement to help Apple make better infrastructure planning and investment decisions.
As a Software Engineer focused on Capacity Planning, you will bring together infrastructure telemetry, workload demand, capacity commitments, and financial data into trusted datasets and data products. You will build the pipelines and analytical foundations used to understand current utilization, forecast future needs, identify capacity gaps, and improve infrastructure efficiency. You will partner with engineering and business teams to turn complex infrastructure data into actionable insights.
Build and maintain data pipelines for infrastructure capacity, utilization, performance, and cost data.
Develop trusted data models for GPU, TPU, CPU, storage, and other infrastructure resources.
Build cost models that calculate unit economics such as cost per GPU hour, cost per job, and cost per 1M tokens using measured production utilization.
Integrate workload demand, utilization telemetry, capacity commitments, and financial data into a common planning framework.
Reconcile model outputs to actuals and implement data-quality controls for missing tags, anomalies, and duplicate records.
Build forecasting and scenario-analysis tools that help leaders evaluate capacity, utilization, and pricing decisions before committing spend.
Identify optimization opportunities such as idle reserved capacity, underutilized clusters, and inefficient workloads, and quantify the associated savings.
Automate recurring capacity-planning, forecasting, and reporting workflows.
Partner with engineering teams to understand workload growth, migrations, SLOs, and architecture changes that affect capacity needs.
Work with CIBO, Finance, and Procurement to support cloud commitments, infrastructure investment decisions, and long-range capacity planning.
Communicate insights, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
Minimum Qualifications
3+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Infrastructure Analytics, or a related field.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Experience with Python or another language used for data processing and automation.
Experience building data pipelines, data models, and analytical datasets.
Understanding of ETL/ELT patterns, data quality, and pipeline reliability.
Experience working with cloud billing and usage data from AWS, GCP or Azure
Proven ability to build data models that reconcile to a financial source of truth
Understanding of AI and ML inference workloads and how model serving drives compute cost
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with infrastructure capacity planning, forecasting, or resource-management data.
Experience working with GPU, TPU, CPU, storage, or cloud infrastructure.
Experience with AWS, GCP, or similar cloud platforms.
Understanding of AI/ML infrastructure and accelerator utilization.
Experience with infrastructure cost, billing, or utilization datasets.
Experience with technologies such as Spark, Trino, Airflow, Kafka, or similar data-platform tools.
Experience with Tableau or other visualization platforms.
Familiarity with infrastructure economics, cloud commitments, or capacity optimization.
Experience partnering with Engineering, Finance, or Procurement on infrastructure planning.

apple-200695462-3337.text:
Apple builds products that are loved by people around the world, products that enrich lives by making powerful technology feel simple, intuitive, and accessible. We're building Apple Intelligence to be the most personalized and integrated intelligence on the planet, with uncompromising privacy and security. We're looking for software engineers to build multimodal Siri experiences that harness AI, machine learning, and computer vision to solve difficult, high-impact problems at scale, in ways that feel effortless to our users. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, system software, and user experience, while upholding Apple's core values of privacy, accessibility, and inclusion.
In this role, you will work across the stack, from system software and frameworks to the end-user interface, to build multimodal Siri features that enrich people's lives. This is a highly cross-functional role, partnering with design, algorithm, privacy, and hardware teams. You will move quickly from idea to robust, production-ready software that millions of people will depend on, and apply strong UX intuition along the way.
This is early work. How people best use an assistant that can see is still an open question, so expect real ambiguity, and expect to prove your ideas with working software and measured results.
Builds and ships multimodal Siri experiences in Swift, from system integration through the user interface.
Prototypes early-stage concepts to validate feasibility and build the case for further investment, then hardens them into production-quality code.
Designs, evaluates, and integrates large language model capabilities into product features, including prompts, context, tool calling, and validation of model output.
Turns camera and sensor data, including image and video, into reliable product behavior, working with multimodal models.
Finds the root causes of bugs across components, processes, and devices, and fixes them.
Owns features and deliverables from design through launch, partnering with design, algorithm, and platform teams, and takes on more ambiguous, cross-team problems as scope grows.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience) and 3+ years of professional software development experience; or a Master's degree and 2+ years; or a PhD.
Strong programming skills in Swift, Objective-C, or C++, with a solid understanding of data structures, memory management, and concurrency.
Experience shipping user-facing software features to production, and communicating clearly with design, product, and engineering partners.
Track record of debugging and root-causing complex problems that span components or processes, using profilers, logs, and system tools.
Fluency with agentic coding tools, with good judgment about where to apply them and how to verify what they produce.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience developing for iOS or macOS, using system frameworks such as SwiftUI, AVFoundation, or ARKit, including API design and performance optimization for resource-constrained or real-time systems.
Background building and shipping features with multimodal models or machine learning, including on-device inference and data-driven validation.
Hands-on work processing camera or sensor data (image, video, audio, motion), using computer vision or signal processing.
Experience developing under strict privacy and security constraints, such as on-device processing and privacy-by-design principles.
Working knowledge building with large language models, including writing and iterating on prompts, constructing context, designing tool or function-calling interfaces, and evaluating model output, through work, research, or personal projects.
Track record of owning a feature or subsystem across teams and prioritizing tangible end-user impact.
A history of mentoring other engineers and raising the quality bar through code review.
